external_id.description: documentId of this same message on the peer instance. This is the identity that makes the conversation two-way: without it a synced message is indistinguishable from a new one, and every run duplicates the whole thread.

origin.description: Where the message was written. A 'remote' message arrived via sync and is never pushed back — that is the loop guard.

synced_at.description: When this message was last exchanged with the peer.

internal_only.description: Staff-to-staff note. Never leaves this instance, so back-office discussion cannot leak into the customer-facing thread.
